next.reason: 1985 'The I-O status ... is set to a value indicating the invalid key condition'; §2023:9.1.14 GR1 'set to a value indicating the invalid key condition as described in 9.1.13.5', whose relative values are §2023:9.1.13.5 GR2-GR4, and the statement rules set them (§2023:14.9.51.4 GR15, §2023:14.9.51.4 GR33, §2023:14.9.35.4 GR21). The added 'if enabled, the EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY exception condition is set to exist' acts only when checking is enabled; status and control flow are the same. (The '34' carve-out is the status-definition record's change, not this one's.)
